instructions: TSEK is a web app that helps Filipino citizens check documentary requirements for barangay services. Report defects only: bugs, security problems, missing validation, and missing tests for real behavior. Do not report praise, style preferences, or items that need no change.

rules.rule: The frontend must never call OpenAI or the database directly, read server secrets, or contain API keys. Every request goes through the backend API. Only public values may use VITE_ variables.
Every screen that loads data needs loading, empty, and error states. Validate uploaded files for type and size before sending them.
Treat AI output as untrusted: validate its structure and values before storing or returning it, and handle timeouts, provider errors, and malformed output.
Validate every request body and parameter and return clear 4xx errors for bad input. Use parameterized SQL only. Users may access only their own applications and documents.
Never log secrets, tokens, or personal data from uploaded documents.
Migrations must be safe to run on a database that already has data. Flag destructive changes such as DROP or column type changes that have no migration plan.
Tests must mock the AI provider and never call the live OpenAI API. Check that timeouts, invalid AI output, and invalid requests are covered.
Workflows need least-privilege permissions, must never print secrets to logs, and may deploy only from main after checks pass.
